item.title: Ford finds a new partner for affordable EVs amid a ‘fight for our lives’
item.description: Ford is promising that more affordable EVs are coming soon. A new partnership will include two Ford-branded electric vehicles, but that’s just the start. more…

item.title: The ‘world’s first flying car’ is now being hand-made in California
item.description: Flying cars are no longer just for the movies. Alef Aeronautics has begun building the first electric flying cars for customers, which are being hand-made in California. more…

item.title: XCharge NA just launched New England’s fastest charging site
item.description: XCharge NA and Cellerate Power have brought online what they say is New England’s fastest EV charging site in Vermont, right at the base of Stratton Mountain Resort. more…

item.title: This tiny EV that’s selling for under $12,000 in Europe is coming to the US
item.description: Is this the tiny “kei” car everyone is talking about? Not exactly. Jeep maker Stellantis announced plans to bring the tiny Fiat Topolino EV, which sells for under $12,000 in Europe, to the US. more…

item.title: Lucid (LCID) vows to fix Gravity software issues ‘imminently’ after complaints
item.description: Is the Lucid Gravity the ultimate luxury electric SUV? It could be, but frustrating software issues are holding it back. Lucid said a fix will be sent out “imminently.” more…

item.title: Subaru’s new electric SUV delivers over 300 miles range and it starts at under $35,000
item.description: Subaru’s smaller, more affordable Uncharted EV will be among the few electric vehicles with a starting price of under $35,000. more…

item.title: Peterbilt takes aim at medium-duty EV market with a full line of new trucks
item.description: Peterbilt has jumped into the MD truck ring with the launch three new medium-duty electric trucks that deliver zero-emissions power, ultra-fast 350 kW charging, and proven, versatile platforms for delivery, utility service, and vocational upfitting. more…

item.title: Is a $10,000 discount enough to overcome your VW ID.Buzz sticker shock?
item.description: VW’s retro-tastic minivan hasn’t been the sales success the company might have wanted, and a lot of that has to do with the van’s sky high price tag. Now, VW is asking: will a $10,000 discount be enough to create some buzz for the ID.Buzz? more…

item.title: Tesla CEO Elon Musk claims driverless Robotaxis coming to Austin in 3 weeks
item.description: Tesla CEO Elon Musk said the company will remove “safety monitors” from the passenger seats of Tesla’s Robotaxi vehicles in “about three weeks,” which would mean we’d see completely driverless Teslas in the Austin area potentially by the end of the year – if that timeline sticks. more…
